test_linear_space_values: test pl.linear_space generates correct values for various start, end, num_samples, and closed interval combinations
test_linear_space_expr: test pl.linear_space with expression arguments for dynamic start, end, and num_samples in a LazyFrame
test_linear_space_temporal: test pl.linear_space with various temporal dtypes including Datetime, Time, and Duration
test_linear_spaces_values: test pl.linear_spaces generates vectorized linear space arrays from DataFrame columns with nullable values
test_linear_spaces_as_array: test pl.linear_spaces with as_array=True to produce Array-typed columns instead of List
